_doc: ALMA-SETI epoch-extension programme: searches of archival execution blocks that the parent survey never searched, either because they breached calibrate_generic.py's per-target download budget or because select_finest_spw.py deduplicates spectral windows by spw_id across EBs and therefore only ever split one EB per correlator setup. Every number here is produced by the UNMODIFIED survey pipeline (/data/SETI/bin) with the same astrometry as the published epoch. "T_at_frequency" is the star-position drift-search statistic read out of the new epoch at the channel nearest the published flagged frequency; "window_max_T" is that window's own maximum.
